description_zh: 资源使用者调用AcceptResourceShareInvitation接受资源共享邀请
name: AcceptResourceShareInvitation

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource sharing invitation.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/450564.html to obtain the ID of the resource sharing invitation
parameters.help_zh:
资源共享邀请ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/450564.html获取资源共享邀请ID
parameters.name: resource_share_invitation_id

ResourceShareInvitation.description_en: The information about the resource sharing invitation

AcceptInvitationFailedDetails.description_en: The detailed reasons why the check for accepting the resource share invitation failed
AcceptInvitationFailedDetails.description_zh: 接受共享单元邀请检查失败详细原因

items.description_en: The detailed reasons why the check for accepting the resource share invitation failed
items.description_zh: 接受共享单元邀请检查失败详细原因

FailureDescription.description_en: The detailed description of the reason why the check for accepting the resource share invitation failed
FailureDescription.description_zh: 接受共享单元邀请检查失败时的详细原因描述
FailureDescription.example: You cannot access the specified resource at this time.

FailureReason.description_en:
The reason why the check for accepting the resource share invitation failed. Valid values:

Unavailable: The resource cannot be shared.
LimitExceeded: The quota of accounts with which the resource can be shared is exceeded.
ZonalResourceInaccessible: The resource is unavailable in this region.
InternalError: An internal server error occurred during the check
FailureReason.description_zh:
接受共享单元邀请检查失败时的原因。取值：

Unavailable：资源不可以共享。
LimitExceeded：资源可共享账号配额超限。
ZonalResourceInaccessible： 资源在此地域不可用。
InternalError：检查过程服务器内部出现错误

OperationType.description_en:
The operation type. Valid values:
Associate: Associate
OperationType.description_zh:
操作类型。取值：
Associate：关联

ResourceArn.description_en: The ARN of the shared resource

ResourceId.description_en: The ID of the shared resource

ResourceType.description_en:
The type of the shared resource.

For more information about the types of resources that can be shared, see [Cloud services that support resource sharing]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/450526.html）
ResourceType.description_zh:
共享资源类型。

支持共享的资源类型，请参见[支持资源共享的云服务]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/450526.html）

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the invitation was created. The time is displayed in UTC

ReceiverAccountId.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the invitee
ReceiverAccountId.description_zh: 被邀请者的阿里云账号ID

ResourceShareId.description_en: The ID of the resource share

ResourceShareInvitationId.description_en: The ID of the resource sharing invitation

ResourceShareName.description_en: The name of the resource share

SenderAccountId.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the inviter

Status.description_en:
The status of the invitation. Valid values:

Pending: The invitation is pending confirmation.
Accepted: The invitation is accepted.
Cancelled: The invitation is canceled.
Rejected: The invitation is rejected.
Expired: The invitation has expired.
AcceptFailed: The invitation failed to be accepted
Status.description_zh:
邀请状态。取值：

Pending：等待确认。
Accepted：接受邀请成功。
Cancelled：已取消。
Rejected：已拒绝。
Expired：已过期。
AcceptFailed：接受邀请失败
